description.value: This study assessed whole-brain atrophy and its progression over 12 months in one patient with Alzheimer’s disease and one patient with behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia using cross-sectional SIENAX and longitudinal SIENA measurements.

spans.text: This study aimed to assess the rate of whole brain atrophy by comparing bvFTD and AD.

description.value: Two patients and five healthy controls underwent structural MRI at baseline and after 1 year; the patients were compared with controls cross-sectionally and with each other longitudinally.
